bootstrap_confidence_intervals.note: Intervals quantify sampling variability for this external evaluation population; they are not clinical uncertainty guarantees.

metrics.evaluation_population: Matched Messidor-2 images with successful inference, adjudicated_gradable=1, and valid adjudicated_dr_grade 0..4; four unmatched label records excluded.
metrics.exclusions: Unmatched label rows are excluded; ungradable rows and unsuccessful inferences are excluded from grade metrics.
metrics.label_mapping: Messidor-2 adjudicated five-point ICDR grade 0..4 mapped 1:1 to the existing APTOS output labels defined in the downloaded label readme.

referable_dr_grade_2_or_worse.rule: true and predicted referable if grade >= 2

artifacts.note: The checkpoint is intentionally excluded from Git. Re-run the documented APTOS training workflow to create it locally.

ground_truth_scope.limitation: The discovered test split has no manual vessel ground-truth masks; no test accuracy metrics are reported.
